name: praxist-scientific-research
title_zh: 不靠付费API，也能把陌生领域的文献底细摸清
tagline_zh: 给科研任务项目先铺路：免密钥查公开文献、数据库、开放获取来源，还能翻本地项目文档，把领域指标、基准、先例。
tagline_en: Prepares research tasks by pulling public lit, databases, open-access sources without keys, plus local docs, to.
desc_en: Gather task-agnostic scientific research context for Praxist task projects using no-key public literature/database/open-access lookup, agent-host web search when available, local project documents, and source/provenance notes. Use when an agent needs to identify domain metrics, benchmarks, prior art, scientific databases, open-access provenance, high-value research directions, or literature-backed
why_zh: 它不替你下结论，而是把「该看什么、去哪看、凭什么信」的上下文打包好，让后续任务少走弯路。
why_en: It doesn't conclude for you—it packages what to read, where to look, and why to trust it, so downstream tasks skip dead ends.
limit_zh: 只做任务前的情报收集，不产出实验设计或结论；依赖宿主自带网页搜索，若无搜索能力则只覆盖公开库与本地文档。
limit_en: Pre-task scoping only—no experiment design or conclusions. Needs agent-host web search; without it, limited to public DBs and local docs. No.
title_en: Map an unfamiliar field's literature without paid APIs
